source: Ma & Zhong (2003) JFM 488:31-78, Part 1, sec. 6 / Fig. 15

conditions.length_scale: L* = sqrt(nu_e x / U_e); R = sqrt(Re_x); omega = R*F
conditions.disturbance_temperature_BC: isothermal, T'|_wall=0 (Fig.15 neutral curve, per Ma & Zhong text; mean flow adiabatic)

quantity: second-mode neutral-branch Reynolds numbers R=sqrt(Re_x) at fixed F=2.2e-4: Branch I (lower) and Branch II (upper)

metrics.headline: 2nd-mode neutral band matches Fig.15 (branch I/II 2.4%/1.0% at F=2.2e-4 with the paper's isothermal disturbance BC, anchors 806/999.6); reference curve is a real 400-DPI pixel-trace (digitized branch points 779/1003 confirm the anchors); 1st-mode cutoff branch tracks, onset partial
metrics.full_curve: pyMack neg_alpha_i=0 contour (isothermal disturbance BC) traced over R=240-2000 (2nd mode) and 450-2000 (1st mode); 2nd-mode band edges match the pixel-digitized Fig.15 in omega; F=2.2e-4 crosses pyMack band at R~787/1010

verdict_reason: At fixed F=2.2e-4, pyMack with the ISOTHERMAL temperature-disturbance BC (T'|_wall=0 -- the BC Ma & Zhong state they used for the Fig.15 neutral curve) places the second-mode Branch I (lower) neutral point at R=786.6 vs Ma & Zhong R=806 (2.40%) and Branch II (upper) at R=1009.9 vs R=999.6 (1.03%). Topology matches: a single closed unstable band bounded by exactly two neutral points. Both branch errors are below the 5% digitization-floor threshold (headline = max = 2.40%) -> agrees. N-converged (N=130 vs N=160 differ <0.2 in R). NOTE: an earlier run used the adiabatic disturbance BC by mistake, giving I=831.0 (3.10%), II=1033.4 (3.38%); switching to the paper's actual isothermal disturbance BC improves the match (3.1/3.4% -> 2.4/1.0%) -- a BC correction, not tuning. The reference Fig.15 curve is a REAL pixel-trace of the 400-DPI crop (calibration in _pixel_calibration.md); as an independent anchor check, F=2.2e-4 crosses the digitized 2nd-mode branches at R=778.8 (branch I, vs 806, 3.4%) and R=1002.5 (branch II, vs 999.6, 0.3%), confirming the digitization is on-curve.
pymack_provenance: verification/second_mode/mazhong2003_m4p5/compute_mazhong_m4p5.py (this session, 2026-06). CompressibleBlasius adiabatic-MEAN-flow M=4.5 base flow (Sutherland, S=110.33 K, Pr=0.72, gamma=1.4) at T_edge=65.15 K; solve_spatial with ISOTHERMAL disturbance temperature BC (T'|_wall=0, matching Ma & Zhong Fig.15), length_scale='L_star', lambda_mu_ratio=1.2, N=130, y_max=40; fixed F=2.2e-4 (omega=R*F); coarse R-sweep 700-1100 then bisection on -alpha_i=0 for the two second-mode neutral crossings.
